issues.on_page: Local 409,536 (Exhibit F); Exhibit D (p4) General column: Charges for Services 376,829, Interest 17,044, Miscellaneous 15,663
issues.issue: This broad 'Local' group is left in 'other', though the report shows what it holds: Charges for Services is 92% of it. The extractor rule says a category holding more than half of the line is used (or the line is split with split_from from the Exhibit D General column, which adds exactly to 409,536). It is a context label, so the context check may also settle it.
issues.resolved: 'Local' is a context label: stays other until the context check (CLAUDE.md 2026-11-05 rule)

issues.issue: The category comes from the fund name, not the printed row label (Charges for Services). This is consistent with the lottery-fund keno ruling, but it is an assumption, and the line has no 'computed' note saying the category is derived.
Road Fund state receipts are most likely highway allocation, but no breakdown is printed. 'Other state aid' is defensible.
